title.narrative: Framework for Strengthening Municipal Infrastructure in Central Asia ¿ Selected Projects of the Water Component

description.narrative: Overall, the Framework aims to improve the availability, reliability and quality of municipal infrastructure in the poorest countries in Central Asia. Projects include water supply and sanitation and solid waste management. Focus is placed on commercialisation of these utilities to ensure operational and financial sustainability once the projects have been completed.

title.narrative: Collection rates to improve from the present level of 80 per cent in 2012 to 90 per cent from 2015 onwards

description.narrative: The indicators of the project achievements are presented in the Paragraph 5. EXPECTED RESULTS of the DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION Annex 1 to the Contribution Agreement DCI ASIA/2013/333285. Blending Restructuring exercise: The indicator is wrongly phrased. title.narrative: Reduction in tonnes of CO2 equivalent derived from the lowering of water losses system wide measured by the amount of nonrevenue water before and after project implementation converted into energy required to produce 1,000 m3 of treated water

description.narrative: Baseline and target included in the original formulation of the indicator: Reduction in tonnes of C02 equivalent derived from the lowering of water losses systemwide measured by the amount of nonrevenue water before and after project implementation (from 4.8 million m3 in 2012 to an estimated 1.7 million m3 in 2017), converted into energy required to produce 1,000 m3 of treated water Blending Restructuring exercise 2020: The indicator is wrongly phrased. The DoA, C333285Annex I.PDF in page 8, presents the narrative description of the indicator together with the method of calculation. A more appropriate indicator phrasing would be: Reduction in tonnes of CO2 equivalent. Moreover, the values encoded in the platform for this indicator represent the water production as per the respective indicator and not the CO2 reduction. The Unit should be changed to CO2 tonnes eq/year. The field Included in original Contract has been changed to YES.

comment.narrative: No formula for calculating the amount of Co2 emissions equivalentyear from energy savings due to reduced water losses is available in the DoA and progress reports. The baseline value in terms of cubic meters of non revenue water i.e. water losses is 48 million.

No formula for calculating the amount of Co2 emissions equivalentyear from energy savings due to reduced water losses is available in the DoA and progress reports. The final target value in terms of cubic meters of non revenue water i.e. water losses is 17 million.
